name: Roblox
description: Build Roblox games with AI in the real Roblox Studio app.
icon_svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M6 2 22 6 18 22 2 18Z"/><path d="m10 9 5 1-1 5-5-1Z"/></svg>
blurb: Turn an idea, model reference or UI mockup into a game you can follow in Roblox Studio.
detail: Connect Roblox, browse accessible games, link local places or create experiments, and build with a persistent project chat. Includes a scoped Studio tool, reference attachments, script snapshots and playtest output. Roblox Studio runs on the Kairos host computer. Public account sign-in requires a configured Roblox OAuth app.
reads: Reads your connected Roblox profile, accessible creations, chosen Studio place and attached references. AI edits require you to connect a Studio window and enable editing.
